import asyncio
from urllib.parse import urljoin

async def act(page):
    """
    Plan:
    1. Navigate to the CMS Pages grid using a relative goto.
    2. Locate the link with the accessible name "404 Not Found" using get_by_role and obtain its href.
    3. Navigate (relative goto) to the edit URL for that page.
    4. Find the Page Title textbox using accessibility selectors and fill in the new title.
    5. Click the Save button (try several accessible names) and wait for the save to complete.

    Knowledge-base functions: none of the provided helper functions apply to this task, so none are used.
    """

    new_title = "Bruh bro you clicked the wrong page"

    # Step 1: go to CMS pages grid (use relative URL)
    await page.goto("/index.php/admin/cms_page/index/")
    await page.wait_for_load_state("domcontentloaded")
    await asyncio.sleep(1)  # allow JS to render

    # Step 2: find the CMS page link for the 404 page by accessible name
    page_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="404 Not Found")
    if await page_link.count() == 0:
        raise RuntimeError('Could not find link with name "404 Not Found" on the CMS pages grid.')

    # Prefer to read the href and navigate via goto (safer than clicking a navigation link and then trying to select elements immediately)
    href = await page_link.first.get_attribute("href")
    if href:
        edit_url = urljoin(page.url, href)
        await page.goto(edit_url)
        await page.wait_for_load_state("domcontentloaded")
    else:
        # If no href attribute is exposed, click the link (this will navigate away)
        await page_link.first.click()
        await page.wait_for_load_state("domcontentloaded")

    await asyncio.sleep(1)

    # Step 4: locate the Page Title field using accessibility-centric selectors
    title_field = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Page Title")
    if await title_field.count() > 0:
        await title_field.first.fill(new_title)
    else:
        # Fallback to get_by_label if role-based lookup didn't find it
        labeled = page.get_by_label("Page Title")
        if await labeled.count() > 0:
            await labeled.first.fill(new_title)
        else:
            raise RuntimeError('Could not find the "Page Title" textbox on the CMS page edit form.')

    # Step 5: click Save using an accessible role-based selector. Try common button names.
    save_btn = page.get_by_role("button", name="Save Page")
    if await save_btn.count() == 0:
        save_btn = page.get_by_role("button", name="Save")
    if await save_btn.count() == 0:
        save_btn = page.get_by_role("button", name="Save CMS Page")
    if await save_btn.count() == 0:
        raise RuntimeError('Could not find a Save button on the CMS page edit form.')

    await save_btn.first.click()

    # Wait for the save action to complete
    try:
        await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle', timeout=10000)
    except Exception:
        await asyncio.sleep(2)

    # Indicate success via printing (test harness may capture stdout)
    print('Updated 404 page title to:', new_title)
